summary: Spoken Australian English assistant commands as the speech side, against a pooled non-speech side of public-domain sounds, environmental recordings, music and ambient noise. One row is one clip labelled speech or not-speech, and a fighter has to make that call. Both mistakes cost something: calling music speech wakes the pipeline for nothing, and missing speech drops the user's words.
notes: Multilingual VAD (English (Australia)): MInDS-14 telephone speech as positives vs non-speech (public-domain sounds, ESC-50, FMA music, ambient noise) negatives. A fighter must fire 'speech' on the speech and stay silent on the noise.
